01As part of a project in Podolí u Bernartic, we delivered a comprehensive solution for managing wastewater…

As part of a project in Podolí u Bernartic, we delivered a comprehensive solution for managing wastewater and rainwater at a private residential property used as a weekend cottage with the option of letting it out. A defining feature of the project was the unsteady wastewater inflow that is typical of holiday properties.

02Wastewater solution

Wastewater solution

Wastewater was dealt with by a combination of:

  • 2× AS-ANASEP anaerobic separator
  • 2× AS-ZEON biological soil filter
03AS-ANASEP anaerobic separator

AS-ANASEP anaerobic separator

The unit provides anaerobic pre-treatment of wastewater and effective separation of suspended solids. In design terms it is a four-chamber septic tank, arranged as an anaerobic baffled reactor with dedicated spaces for sedimentation and the separation of solid particles. This solution is particularly well suited to places where the load on the system is irregular.

04AS-ZEON biological soil filter

AS-ZEON biological soil filter

The second treatment stage is provided by the AS-ZEON biological soil filter. Treatment here takes place in an aerobic environment, while also making use of the sorption properties of specially selected filter materials.

The key element of the system is pulse loading of the filter by a tipping device located directly beneath the inlet to the filter chamber. A larger volume of pre-treated water from the septic tank first collects here; it then tips under its own weight and floods the entire filter surface evenly in one go. This makes maximum use of the filter area and at the same time eliminates the risk of short-circuiting flow.

05Rainwater management

Rainwater management

The project also included a comprehensive rainwater solution using AS-REWA COMBI technology, which comprises:

  • an AS-PURAIN treatment unit,
  • an inlet pipe to calm the inflow,
  • pumping technology,
  • the option of topping up with water from a well or another alternative source.

In this project the treated rainwater is used:

  • for flushing toilets,
  • for watering the garden, thanks to pipework laid across the whole plot.
06In conclusion

In conclusion

The project in Podolí u Bernartic is an example of an efficient and sustainable solution for places where wastewater inflow is not steady and where the emphasis is on making maximum use of the available water resources.
